question: An item is sold at two successive discounts of 20 percent and 20 percent. The selling price of article after second discount is Rs. 3616. If it is sold only at one discount of 20 percent, then what will be the selling price of the article?
solution:
Given:

An item is sold at two successive discounts of 20 percent and 20 percent. The selling price of article after second discount is Rs. 3616. If it is sold only at one discount of 20 percent

Formula Used:

Single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of a % and b %

= (a + b - (ab)/(100))% 

 

Calculation:

Here, a = 20% , and b = 20 %

So, the single discount gets, (20 + 20 - 20 × 20/100) %

⇒ (40 - 4) %

⇒ 36 %

After getting discount of 36 % , he has to pay 64%

As per the question,

Value of 64% = 3616

Again, After getting discount of 20 % , he has to pay 80%

So value of 80% is ,

⇒ (3616 / 64) × 80 = Rs 4520

**∴ The correct option is 3**
